decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-763e8d85f263], is a one-line changelog feature entry: "Shard `avg_over_time` range aggregations". It doesn't say whether the sharding applies to existing queries by default (behavior-change) or is a purely additive capability (none), what controls it, or whether results or performance change. The proposed statement about "enabling new query optimization capabilities" is an interpretation the excerpt doesn't support. The PR description or the upgrade-guide text is needed to set the consequence kind.
